#  dsh-statusline-plus
English | 简体中文
A responsive statusline for DeepSeek Harness (`dsh web`). Account quotas appear in the header; works
pace and session metrics appear beside the composer.
## Screenshots
Screenshots use the actual UI with sample data, without account or conversation data.
## Features
- **Balances and quotas:** DeepSeek, Kimi Code, Z.ai / Zhipu, Claude, Antigravity, Codex, OpenCode G
o and OpenRouter, plus other subscriptions your Magpie reports. Click a chip for details and refresh

.
- **DeepSeek peak hours:** status, countdown and daily timeline, plus a sidebar indicator. In a ye
ar with no calendar, a weekday inside a peak window stays unknown while weekends and hours outside t
he windows are still off-peak; when the official rule wording no longer matches, the schedule is sti

ll applied and the indicator warns that rules may have changed.
- **Workspace and session:** Git bra
nch and changes, context usage, streaming TPS, API reference cost, direct child agents and tool acti

vity.
- **Layout:** component switches, ordering, presets and an interactive preview. Groups wrap on
narrow screens; an optional switch disables this plugin's bottom status line when the input area is

at most 480px wide, including when sidebars narrow it.
- **Self-update:** when npm publishes a newe
r version, the settings header shows an update button naming it (checked when the page opens, cached
for a minute; hover shows the installed and latest versions). It stays hidden otherwise, is not off
ered for a linked development checkout, and installs in place on one click, using the Host's own `ds
h plugin add` and falling back to `pnpm`. The Host then swaps the new copy into the running profile
through HMR, so a refresh is enough; a profile without HMR asks for a restart instead.
## Installation
Requires DSH **0.2.0-rc.2 or later**, with no upper bound, so a DSH upgrade never disables the plugi
n; tested on **0.2.0-rc.2**, **0.2.1-rc.2** and the Windows Desktop build (**0.2.1-rc.3**). Install
on **0.2.0-rc.2**, **0.2.1-rc.2** and the Windows Desktop build (**0.2.1-rc.3**). Install from npm:

The same release is also published as a GitHub Release tarball for pinned and offline installs:

For development, install a local clone with `dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-statusli
ne-plus`. The bundle registers its own plugin row and ships prebuilt files. With HMR enabled, plugin
switches and settings apply live; linked source changes also hot reload when their directory is wat
ched. Refresh the browser afterward. Restart DSH only when installation or an upgrade reports `resta
rt-required`, and wait until no sessions are active.
For an earlier manual installation, remove the `@local/dsh-statusline-plus` row and dependency first
to avoid duplicate registration. Existing `statusline-plus` settings remain compatible. See release
id duplicate registration. Existing `statusline-plus` settings remain compatible. See release notes.

Open **DSH Web → Settings → Statusline**. Settings are saved under `statusline-plus` in the native p

The narrow-screen switch is in **Bottom status line**. It affects this plugin's bottom components; h
eader quotas, peak indicators and native composer stats remain available.

## Limits
- Quota requests use a plugin-owned connection pool with a 5-second address-attempt window; request
timeouts still bound the whole operation (Codex: 15 seconds), and Host network defaults stay unchang
ed. Successful queries update the display immediately, without waiting for the connection window to
end. Quota refreshes reuse cached results; expiry alone does not poll. Network failures retry at mos
t three times after 15/30/60 seconds; rate-limit retries wait 60/120/240 seconds. Going offline paus
es recovery; coming online, becoming visible, a new step or a manual refresh starts a fresh query cy
cle. Regaining focus resumes failed recovery once the active retry cycle has ended. Successful data
remains visible during retries; chips explain network errors and exhausted retries. Credential and i
nvalid-response errors require correction. Manual refresh bypasses successful cache, while error/rat

e-limit backoff still applies. Missing or invalid data stays unknown.
